newsitem.title: USA: Centocor to settle suit over ReoPro.
newsitem.headline: Centocor to settle suit over ReoPro.

text.p: Centocor Inc said Friday it has agreed to pay at least $10.8 million to settle a suit brought by Centocor Partners III LP over Centocor's pact with Eli Lilly and Co for distribution of ReoPro.
The settlement, which requires approval of the Delaware Chancery Court, calls for:
-- Centocor to pay Centocor Partners $10.8 million, net of attorneys fees and expenses;
-- Centocor to pay another $5 million if aggregate world-wide sales of ReoPro exceed $600 million;
-- Centocor possibly to pay another $2.2 million depending upon regulatory developments in Japan; and
-- Centocor to revise the ReoPro royalties payable to Centocor Partners investors.
A company spokesman did not immediately return a phone call to provide further details.
